ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Culture Characters（中世日本 - 文化・人物）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Ancient & Medieval Japan - Culture Characters adapts pawn backgrounds and traits for ancient-to-medieval Japanese play.
Existing backgrounds rewritten: 126 (123 earlier historical rewrites + 3 original Core occupations; names/descriptions adjusted without adding new biographies). New backgrounds eligible for ordinary generation: 12 (8 adulthood, 4 childhood). There are 14 new BackstoryDef IDs in total, but 2 duplicate roles are kept only for save compatibility and are not normal generation candidates. Existing backgrounds excluded from ordinary generation: 135 (preserved, not deleted). New traits: 2 (alcohol lover / alcohol averse). 23 historical starting-possession substitutions are separate changes.
Harmony required. Medieval Overhaul optional; current separated AMJ Culture optional. Do not co-install with older unsplit Culture builds. RimWorld 1.6/1.7 focused native acceptance completed, including the original 1.6 MO + Culture + Characters combination. New game recommended; existing-save compatibility and MO 1.7 remain unverified. This is an unpublished development build.
中世日本に合わせて人物の背景・特性を調整する。
既存背景の改稿：126件（既存の123件＋Core職業背景3件）。名称・説明文を改稿するもので、新規背景の追加ではない。 新規背景：通常生成対象12件（成人8件・幼少期4件）。新規定義自体は14件だが、重複する2件は旧セーブとの識別子互換のため保持し、通常生成から除外。 既存背景の通常生成制限：135件（削除はしない）。 新規特性：2件（酒好き・酒嫌い）。既存の初期所持品変更23件は別項目。
Harmony必須。Medieval Overhaul・分離済みの現行AMJ Cultureは任意。分離前の旧Cultureとは併用不可。1.6／1.7で限定的な実ゲーム検証済み（1.6 MO併用を含む）。新規ゲーム推奨。旧セーブ互換・MO 1.7は未検証。未公開の開発版。
